detail: The City of Florence records the existing landmark by Florence Mall, its 1974 construction and the change from Florence Mall to Florence Y’all.
The municipal budget describes the words in two lines, Florence above Y’all. The structure was erected to serve the growing water system.
The city confirms that the tower is standing and in water-service use in 2026.
State first-return surface from 2019–2024 KyFromAbove lidar has a native 2 US survey foot sample spacing.
